Whoa, I don't know if I have the composure to save up for three at a time. I'd go crazy wanting to find if I got stuff. But that does seem reasonable. I don't want to use the money, and I wouldn't feel like I've earned it.

Though, also, a friend of mine says she knows of (and has successfully exploited) a glitch to get a ton of credits quickly, which I'm very much considering trying. I just want to make a ton of credits fast so I can get to the stuff I want instead of being frustrated at working hard to get nothing.

Damn the store. Let me summarize on the store: it consistently gives me items, characters & XP, and equipment that I will hardly ever use, if at all. And by consistently, I mean every single time. Is it too much to ask for shotgun upgrades and heavy pistols?
